headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.9
summary: YouTube videos in CurseForge listings finally play: the player no longer rejects the WebView as an unknown browser, so the image viewer and description embeds work end to end.

items.text: Playing YouTube videos from a CurseForge screenshot gallery no longer fails with error 152 - the WebView user agent no longer carries the marker that makes the player refuse playback.
YouTube embeds inside project descriptions benefit from the same fix.
